description: Defines the Float8_e5m2 type (8-bit floating-point) including conversions to standard C types and basic arithmetic operations, based on a specific binary format (sign, exponent, mantissa). Implements conversions to/from float and provides special value helpers and operator overloads.

classes.name: Float8_e5m2
classes.description: 8-bit floating point type with conversion and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: fp8e5m2_to_fp32_value
methods.description: Converts 8-bit fp8 E5M2 format to 32-bit float without using floating-point operations.

methods.name: fp8e5m2_from_fp32_value
methods.description: Converts 32-bit float to 8-bit fp8 E5M2 format.
